brief: A neat stack of crisp white sheets sits squarely in the center of a wooden desk, illuminated by a warm brass desk lamp. A fountain pen rests across the top blank sheet, casting a sharp shadow. The surrounding room is quiet, making the clean white layers the absolute focus of the frame.
prompt: A neat stack of crisp white sheets sits squarely in the center of a wooden desk, illuminated by a warm brass desk lamp. A fountain pen rests across the top blank sheet, casting a sharp shadow. The surrounding room is quiet, making the clean white layers the absolute focus of the frame. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
